title: Implement a Skip Navigation Link
description: Add a fully functional skip-to-main link to an existing page template.
problemStatement:
## Skip Link Implementation You are given a basic HTML page with a header containing many navigation links. Add a skip navigation link that: 1. Is the very first focusable element on the page. 2. Is visually hidden until it receives focus. 3. Links to the `
` element (id="main-content"). 4. The `
` element must have `tabindex="-1"` so it can receive focus (and have `outline: none` to prevent a visible focus ring on the main container). 5. When clicked/focused+entered, focus moves to the `
` and the user can then press Tab to continue to the first interactive element inside main. Write the HTML and CSS for the skip link. The existing page structure is: ```html
Home Products ...

Welcome

...

...
``` Provide the complete code for the skip link and the CSS.
hints: Use `position: absolute; left: -999px;` to visually hide, then set `position: static;` on focus.
Add `tabindex="-1"` to `<main>` and style it with `outline: none`.
expectedOutput: A working skip link that passes keyboard testing.
solutionCode: Skip to main content
